findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sv_fsds · Private data: orkid_quote, orkid_swap_link, orkid_chains, orkid_bridge_quote, sv_fsds, sv_filings, sv_aml, sv_fsds_bulk · Public sink: orkid_quote, sv_futures · Destructive: sv_index_events, sv_aml_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sv_fsds · Private data: orkid_quote, orkid_swap_link, orkid_chains, orkid_bridge_quote, sv_fsds, sv_filings, sv_aml, sv_fsds_bulk · Public sink: orkid_quote, sv_futures · Destructive: sv_index_events, sv_aml_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
